{{Top|leg}}
A '''med sprinter''' was a type of small, in-[[Star system/Legends|system]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was often carried aboard much larger [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. During [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]], these small craft would dart about the battle planes, rescuing extravehicular [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] or extracting wounded personnel from damaged or abandoned combat vessels. These ships often carried a medical corpsman in addition to a pilot.
